accepted job to TimescaleDB, then publishes it to intake; admission releases jobs to Temporal as capacity allows, so 100,000 submissions wait in a queue instead of becoming 100,000 live workflows. Temporal asks the scheduler to place each task, then schedules it on the chosen pool's Temporal task queue; workers poll it directly. The scheduler never moves messages. div.div: The Dispatch API writes each accepted job to TimescaleDB, then publishes it to intake; admission releases jobs to Temporal as capacity allows, so 100,000 submissions wait in a queue instead of becoming 100,000 live workflows. Temporal asks the scheduler to place each task, then schedules it on the chosen pool's Temporal task queue; workers poll it directly. The scheduler never moves messages. The dashed top path is the control plane.
